microtenant-limit.statement: The ranges and limitations article allows 100 Microtenants.

connector-versions.statement: To configure a Microtenant, App Connectors and Private Service Edges for Private Access must be running version 24.63.1 or later.

quotes: To configure a Microtenant, App Connectors and Private Service Edges for Private Access must be running version 24.63.1 or later.

dr-unsupported.statement: The Microtenants feature is not supported when disaster recovery is enabled.

default-only-features.statement: These features are supported only for a Default Microtenant and not for a standard Microtenant: AI-Powered Recommendations for Application Segments, Application Segments Usage, AppProtection for Private Application Traffic, Authentication Service, Browser Access with CORS, Client Hostname Validation, Disaster Recovery, Extranet Application Support, Inspect Traffic with ZIA, Log Streaming Service, Source IP-Anchor enabled applications, VPN (for Legacy Apps), Zscaler Branch Connector and Zscaler Cloud Connector.
